text:
Priya: Quick sync — posting the consolidated action slate from the postmortem. Please confirm owner/due or reply with changes. I want to lock dates by EOD tomorrow.

Priya: Proposed list (from notes):
```
1) Add KV-cache telemetry to runtime -> Miguel -> due: 2026-04-02
2) Docs: canary rollback playbook -> Carla -> due: 2026-03-30
3) Model fallback mapping + tests -> Devon -> due: 2026-04-06
4) Customer comms + support runbook -> Ben -> due: 2026-03-29
5) Audit log export fix (private deploy) -> Miguel -> due: 2026-04-01
```

Priya: Also note cross-team deps: (a) runtime telemetry needs infra credentials from eng-infra, (b) fallback mapping blocks canary test which Dev-oncall owns. Call out if any dates are unrealistic.

Miguel: ACK on 1 and 5, will take them. Heads-up: infra creds ETA is 3 days, so 1 might slip to 2026-04-05 unless creds come earlier.

Carla: Can we move the docs playbook to 2026-04-01? I need a day to coordinate with legal for the rollback phrasing. Otherwise I can do an initial draft by 03-30 but final by 04-01.

Devon: For 3 — yes I own it. Note that the fallback mapping requires the new KV-cache telemetry (item 1) to validate perf regressions. If telemetry slips, I propose we decouple validation and run a limited canary using synthetic traces; that would keep my due date at 04-06 but require a short QA task from eng-sre.

Ben: Will handle 4. Can we target 03-31 for comms? Product wants to push an interim status update on 03-29 but we'll need a short FAQ from support. If support can do FAQ in 48h I can make 03-29; otherwise 03-31.

Priya: Noted. Action items from replies: Miguel -> adjust item1 to 2026-04-05 if infra not ready; Carla -> final docs by 04-01 (initial draft 03-30); Devon -> keep 04-06 but add QA stub if telemetry delayed; Ben -> aim for 03-29 contingent on support FAQ; Miguel -> confirm audit log fix 04-01 still ok.

Miguel: Audit log fix still on for 04-01, no blockers there. :thumbsup:

Carla: I'll put draft up in the docs repo by EOD today and ping for reviews.

Devon: I'll add the QA stub task in the canary checklist and tag @miguel for telemetry validation.

Ben: I'll coordinate with support; pinging @Carla to include rollback FAQ in the comms doc.

IncidentBot: Reminder set — update the RCA action sheet within 24 hours or the thread will reopen for escalation.

Priya: Thanks. I'll update the action sheet with the revised dates and owners (will mark item1 as tentative) and post a short follow-up later today. If anyone needs to reassign, reply here or update the sheet directly. :slightly_smiling_face:
